commit.merge_subject: merge: per digit timecode cells adaptive format

description:
owner round 3b: the round-3a fix pinned the readout's LAYOUT BOX
(widthIn min = widest pair) but the pair stayed ONE text run, and
the owner's device test isolated the residual mechanism: the
current time's frames field jitters and the " / " + total jitter
with it, while the current's hh/mm/ss never move. In one text run
a glyph's x is the cumulative advance of every glyph before it, so
the fast-ticking frames digits (proportional on the tnum-ignoring
device font) breathe the run's width and drag everything after
them inside the pinned box.

The definitive fix splits the readout so no node's width depends
on another node's content:

- every DIGIT of the current half renders in its own measured
  cell (width = max advance over the ten single-glyph probes,
  glyph centered), with static ":" Texts between fields
- a static " / " node
- the total in its own fixed box (measured max over the r
